caption: The drawing depicts a single object, which is a pouch or bag made from a brown material with visible darker lines indicating creases and folds. The pouch is elongated with a rounded bottom and a slightly flared opening at the top. There are two horizontal tan-colored stripes, one near the top and the other near the bottom, running parallel to each other around the body of the pouch. At the top, two holes are visible, through which a tan drawstring is threaded, with the ends of the drawstring extending upward and slightly to the right, forming loose loops. The background is plain and off-white, with some faint discoloration and a barely visible border. The drawing appears to be done in muted watercolor or colored pencil, with attention to the texture and shading of the pouch. The lower right corner of the paper has a handwritten signature, "Roberta Spicer."
title: Money Bag
